$comment: Default stake-tier rooms (remediation C2). Tier configs live here — server config, not code. Casuals never share a room with 100× their stake, and each tier steps ×10 from the last: Skiff 1–50, Schooner 5–500, Flagship 50–5,000, Galleon 500–50,000, Leviathan 5,000–500,000 credits. botsAllowed only takes effect under LANDFALL_ENV=demo; any other environment refuses to start if a room requests bots (C5). botCount/botBankrollMinor are per-tier: a Leviathan bot on a Skiff bankroll is broke on its first anchor, so the rich tables would look deserted. LIQUIDITY: seedMinor is the CEILING (a dead table); the house tops the table up to liquidityFloorMinor and then falls away to minSeedMinor as real players arrive — a large flat seed averages the pools together and flattens every payout to the same number (see packages/core/src/liquidity.ts). Every tier's floor is sized so that liquidityFloorMinor/3 (the B5 whale cap on a dead table) is comfortably above minStakeMinor — otherwise the first bettor of a round would be rejected by a guardrail meant for whales.
